Ontology_TreatmentAndDesign_prompt.notes: The proteomics component of this study (AP/MS) specifically compares the interactomes of RAS proteins in their active (GTP-locked) versus inactive (GDP-locked) states. While the study also performs extensive CRISPR dual knockout (CDKO) screens, those are genetic interaction assays and not the primary focus of the mass spectrometry data extraction. The 'renilla luciferase' served as a negative control bait.
